name: Hitozuma♪ Kasumi-san 2 ~Oku-sama - Miboujin Owner to Kyoudou Seikatsu~
original_name: 人妻♪かすみさん2～奥様・未亡人オーナーと共同性活～
source:
Main character gets separated from his niece after their intimate relations uncover. One day younger sister of the niece introduces him to a part-time job in a pension at a summer resort. Protagonist jumps at the opportunity welcomed by the hospitable resort owner and inhabitants.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角与侄女的亲密关系曝光后，他们分开了。有一天，侄女的妹妹向他介绍了一份在避暑胜地养老金的兼职工作。主角抓住了受到热情好客的度假村老板和居民欢迎的机会。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
